period_note: SOLO/SEPARATE basis, from the Half-Yearly (unaudited) filing's 'Condensed Balance Sheet'/'Condensed Profit & Loss Account' pages headed just 'Eastern Bank PLC.' (as distinct from the 'Condensed Consolidated' pages earlier in the same PDF). Per project-wide convention, this Half-Yearly (Jan-Jun) filing is used as the Q2 data point. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2026 (column header '01 January 2026 to 30 June 2026'), flagged via the _cumulative suffix — same convention as CITYBANK and as EBL's own 2026_Q1.json. Unusually, this particular filing ALSO discloses a discrete second-quarter-only column ('01 April 2026 to 30 June 2026') as a bonus, which is not part of line_items but was used for cross-validation (see below). EXTRACTION NOTE: same font-encoding corruption as 2026_Q1.json affects this filing's Solo section under plain pdftotext -layout (e.g. the Solo balance sheet heading literally mis-renders as 'As at 30 June 2025' — confirmed via OCR to actually read 'As at 30 June 2026'; the year is correct, this was purely a digit-glyph rendering bug, not a real error in the source document). All figures below were sourced via OCR (pdftoppm 300dpi + tesseract) of the Solo Balance Sheet/P&L/notes pages (PDF pages 7-9, 16). Cross-validated: (1) internal arithmetic — operating_income - operating_expenses = operating_profit exactly (16,470,154,536 - 7,067,111,028 = 9,403,043,508); operating_profit - total_provision = PBT exactly (9,403,043,508 - 1,659,760,061 = 7,743,283,447); PBT - tax = PAT within BDT 1 of rounding (7,743,283,447 - 3,452,296,746 = 4,290,986,701 vs reported 4,290,986,700); assets = liabilities + equity within BDT 1 of rounding; classified_loans/gross_loans = 15,195,976,748/466,056,410,455 = 3.261%, matching the filing's own reported NPL% of 3.26%. (2) the comparative '31 December 2025' column matches bank_financials/EBL/quarterly/2025_Q4.json exactly for every line item checked (same set as 2026_Q1.json). (3) discrete Q2-only PAT (2,288,522,963, from this filing's bonus column) plus 2026_Q1.json's profit_after_tax_cumulative (2,002,463,737) = 4,290,986,700, matching this filing's own H1 cumulative PAT exactly — strong cross-check that both quarters were read correctly. NOTABLE PATTERN (see also insights.json): total_equity dips from Q1's 53,053m to Q2's 51,149m despite Q2 alone being solidly profitable (PAT 2,289m). This is fully explained, not a data error: paid-up capital rose 15,958m to 16,437m (bonus share issue) and dividend equalisation reserve rose 356m to 1,154m, both funded out of retained earnings, alongside an implied cash dividend outflow — consistent with an AGM approving and paying the FY2025 dividend during Q2 2026 (Apr-Jun), a seasonal pattern not previously visible in this dataset's Q4-only series.
